help
RT-Thread shell commands:
event            - event capture control: status arm trigger_test export clear
sysinfo          - show transport recorder system information
log              - event log status and explicit format
reboot           - Reboot System
pin              - pin [option]
clear            - clear the terminal screen
version          - show RT-Thread version information
console          - console setting
list             - list objects
help             - RT-Thread shell help
ps               - List threads in the system
free             - Show the memory usage in the system
backtrace        - print backtrace of a thread
memcheck         - check memory data
memtrace         - dump memory trace information
